projects.title: ICONIC ENVIRO SOLUTIONS
projects.desc: A custom-built, admin-managed marketing website for Iconic Enviro Solutions, with a Filament admin portal for content, enquiries, and newsletters. Built on Laravel and deployed on Hostinger.
projects.longDesc: Iconic Enviro Solutions is a client website built to present the company’s services, projects, and credentials. It gives the client full control over the content without touching code. The public site is a responsive, partial-based homepage in which any section left empty in the admin is hidden automatically. Visitors can browse the projects portfolio, send enquiries through the contact form, and subscribe to the newsletter.
features: Admin-managed homepage, projects gallery (Before & After and photos/videos), and branding
Newsletter system with scheduled campaigns and signed unsubscribe links
